terminology: Descriptor counts are encoding channels, not distinct physical models or additional effects.
scope: Existing clauses only. No new clause or recipient is inferred for an uncontracted textual rule.

legacyReads.stratagemCompatibility: compatibility-feasibility.mjs retains effectRecipientRoleIds for STRATAGEM only.
legacyReads.sourceDeclarations: Producer-only compiler and declaration validators read accepted existing input encodings. They do not provide a runtime fallback.
legacyReads.csmMetricLoweringParameters: Two effect.parameters.unitScope values remain producer inputs for Charge-roll lowering in books/chaos-space-marines/v2/roster-effect-build.mjs. That producer spreads the parameters into scratch effects before canonical compilation. Runtime execution resolves scope from recipientId instead.

tauReviewAnnotations.meaning: Frozen source-review descriptions, not executable selectors. Corresponding canonical clause annotations explicitly state reviewedRecipient.runtimeSelector=false. These descriptions do not establish new recipients.

legacyReads.validationViews: recipientDeclarationView produces a temporary inverse for source evidence guards; no old recipient fields are serialized into migrated canonical clauses.
legacyReads.executionViews: resolveExecutionEffect derives temporary operation arguments from recipientId. Physical execution and provenance fields retain their original meaning.
